description.title: A collaboration between residents, supervisors & HR
description.subtitle: Med@Work centralises on-call scheduling, absence tracking and timesheet validation — so every team member can focus on what matters.
description.item0Desc: The app installs easily on a smartphone and allows quick entry of hours worked, on-call shifts and available leave days. Enable notifications to be reminded before monthly close — so you always stay up to date.
description.item1Desc: Manage schedules in real time to comply with legal requirements. Ensure resident rotation to maintain balance. Involve HR in the timely validation of schedules. Avoid blind signing of illegible timesheets.
description.item2Desc: Receive a notification of monthly validation by clinical supervisors. The schedule generator lets you enter billing hours easily and without inconsistencies. You can then store them in your archives.

advertising.title: Everything your team needs
advertising.subtitle: From creating a training year to exporting validated timesheets, Med@Work covers the full administrative cycle of your medical training programme.
advertising.claimSub: Focus on your patients, not your spreadsheets.

features.sectionSub: A complete platform for every stakeholder in medical training.
features.f1Desc: Create and configure your training years in a few clicks — speciality, hospital, team and dates.
features.f2Desc: View the whole team's schedules in real time through an interactive calendar.
features.f3Desc: Define reusable model weeks to speed up the creation of weekly schedules.
features.f4Desc: Log worked hours, on-call shifts and leave days quickly from any device.
features.f5Desc: Validate monthly timesheets online, paperless, with full traceability.
features.f6Desc: Generate billing-ready schedule tables exportable in one click to your HR department.
features.f7Desc: Assign precise roles to each manager: data access, validation, calendar and administration.
features.f8Desc: Receive reminders before monthly close and validation alerts so nothing slips through.
features.f9Desc: Install Med@Work directly from your browser — no app store needed.
features.f10Desc: Interface available in French, English and Dutch for all your teams.
features.f11Desc: Track every action on your training year through a detailed audit log.
features.f12Desc: View attendance and on-call statistics for each resident throughout their placement.

tutorial.title: How to use the Week Creator

steps.title: Week templates
steps.text: Each tab at the top represents a reusable template (e.g. 'Normal week', 'On-call week'). You can create as many as needed and switch between them with a click.

steps.title: Create a template
steps.text: Click the + button (dashed border) to create a new template. Give it a name and a colour, then confirm.

steps.title: Rename / edit a template
steps.text: Select a template, then click the pencil icon on its right to rename it or change its colour.

steps.title: Select a day
steps.text: Click on a day name in the timeline (left column) to target it. The added task will be linked to that day.

steps.title: Add a task
steps.text: Enter a title, a start time and an end time, then click 'Add'. The task appears instantly in the timeline.

steps.title: Edit or delete a task
steps.text: Click a task in the timeline to load it into this form. Edit it and confirm, or click the 🗑️ icon to delete it.

steps.title: Drag and drop between days
steps.text: Drag a task horizontally and drop it on another day's row to move it without going through the form.

steps.title: Hours summary
steps.text: The right column shows the total hours for each day and the weekly total. The progress bar at the top shows the workload relative to 72 h.

help.title: How to use messages?
help.intro: Messages let you send targeted communications to your hospital's users — residents, managers, or administrators.
types: Appears in the bell icon at the top right. The user can read it and mark it as read from their notification centre.
Automatically shown as a popup the next time the user logs in. Ideal for important announcements.
scopes: Sends the message to all members of your hospital.
Targets only residents, managers, or hospital admins.
Sends to a single person identified by name.
optionals: For notifications: redirects the user to a page in the app when they click the message. E.g.: /hospital-admin/dashboard
If multiple modals are pending, the one with the lowest value is shown first.
help.deactivateNote: A message can be deactivated at any time without deleting it — it will no longer be visible to users. You can also duplicate it to reuse its structure.

finalCta.sub: A 20-minute demo is enough to understand how Med@Work can adapt to your service. We answer your questions and show you the tool on your real use cases.
finalCta.quoteText: I am very satisfied with this application for monitoring assistant schedules. It allows you to set up a forward-looking schedule and consult timetables in real time week by week. The team summary gives an immediate overview of overtime and makes it easy to send emails to assistants and supervisors to apply the necessary corrections. The application is also very user-friendly, and its accessibility on both smartphone and PC enables regular, efficient monitoring.
